A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same transformer masked-reconstruction study. The main text, figures, equations, and complete proof appendices are readable and can be matched despite the changed title and extensive reorganization.

before.justification: Section 6 and Figure 3 report original attention-diversity measurements across 152 images for MAE, MoCo v3, DINO, and DeiT.

after.justification: Section 6 retains those original measurements in Figure 2. Figure 1 additionally presents a qualitative comparison of query-dependent attention maps.

M1.justification: The analyzed model retains single-layer softmax attention, fixed positional embeddings and identity value weights, random zero masking, masked reconstruction loss, zero initialization, and gradient descent. Rewritten matrix conventions and terminology do not change the operative procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions study attention in ImageNet-1K-pretrained ViT-B/16 models using 152 example images. The added bird-image visualization remains within the same image-attention task and introduces no distinct dataset, domain, or input condition.

E2.justification: The quantitative comparison retains MAE, MoCo v3, DINO, and DeiT. The new attention-map illustration reuses MAE, DINO, and MoCo; no comparator is added to or removed from the retained experiment.

E3.justification: V2 adds a diagnostic that visualizes last-layer attention for two selected query locations in Figure 1. The retained quantitative protocol is unchanged: ViT-B/16, 12 last-layer heads, top-10 attention locations, and 152 images.

E4.justification: V2 Figure 1 adds a qualitative case study testing whether attention changes with query location: MAE is contrasted with the more similar DINO and MoCo attention maps. No new ablation or sensitivity study is added.

E5.justification: The same box plots describe variability across 152 images. Neither version reports repeated-training seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests, and v2 introduces no new uncertainty-estimation practice.

E6.justification: The quantitative plot is identical in v1 Figure 3 and v2 Figure 2. V2 Figure 1 adds qualitative results showing MAE's attention changing between query locations while DINO and MoCo retain similar object-focused patterns.

T1.justification: The convergence guarantee and detailed phase proofs are retained. Theorem 4.2 largely restates dynamics already described in v1 Section 5 and Appendix F, but adds explicit O(log(P)/eta) correlation-size statements. V2 Lemma B.4 also corrects the cluster summation range from [N] in v1 Lemma A.4 to [K].

C1.justification: Both versions claim an end-to-end convergence analysis of masked reconstruction with one-layer transformers, explain diverse local attention through feature-position correlations, and introduce the attention-diversity metric. Rewritten contribution statements preserve these claims and their scope.

C2.justification: V2 Figure 3 explicitly clarifies that the data model permits non-contiguous areas despite the contiguous illustration. This adds an applicability qualification; the central interpretation of feature-position learning and attention diversity remains unchanged.

D1.justification: The retained experiment has the same reported model, pretraining dataset, layer, head count, sample count, and metric construction. V2 adds no substantive implementation, hardware, runtime, preprocessing, or code/data-access information.

R1.justification: Section 7 adds discussion and citations for JoMA, max-margin token selection, and implicit bias and fast convergence for self-attention. The multi-view background citation AZL20 is removed. The principal positioning relative to transformer spatial-structure theory and CNN-based MAE analysis remains.

P1.justification: V2 changes the title and extensively rewrites the abstract, introduction, setup, and theoretical exposition. It separates convergence and dynamics into two main theorem statements, replaces the main proof overview with a shorter sketch, and moves the detailed overview to Appendix A while retaining the subsequent proofs.

P2.justification: The visual exposition is substantially reorganized: v2 adds attention-map Figure 1, moves the unchanged quantitative plot into the introduction as Figure 2, redraws the data-distribution diagram as Figure 3, and relocates the existing mechanism illustration to the proof sketch as Figure 4. Captions are also revised.

improvement.justification: V2 improves accessibility through a clearer separation of convergence and learning dynamics, a shorter proof sketch backed by the retained detailed appendices, and a concrete attention-map illustration. The applicability clarification, small mathematical correction, and updated related work add modest value. The core theory and quantitative evidence remain largely unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
